_comment: Gold-standard extraction cases, French. ENTIRELY SYNTHETIC: no real person,
consultation or facility is represented, and none of these came from a real
record. CONTRIBUTING.md forbids real patient data in any fixture and this is
the file that rule most obviously applies to.
Written as dictation transcripts, because that is what the extractor actually
receives: the browser's recogniser emits a run-on string with no punctuation
to speak of, spoken numerals, and no field boundaries. Cases lifted from
clean written prose would measure something the app never sees.
`expect` holds only what a rule should find. A field absent from `expect` and
present in the output is a false positive; present in `expect` and absent from
the output is a false negative. `notes` explains what each case is testing so
a failure is diagnosable without reverse-engineering the string.

cases.notes: Baseline. Spoken numerals, decimal as 'virgule', cmHg blood pressure convention.
cases.text: Motif fièvre depuis trois jours. Température trente-huit virgule cinq, pouls quatre-vingt-douze, tension douze sur huit. Diagnostic paludisme simple. Paracétamol 500 mg trois fois par jour pendant cinq jours.

cases.notes: The irregular French compounds: soixante-quinze, quatre-vingt-dix-huit.
cases.text: Pouls soixante-quinze, saturation quatre-vingt-dix-huit pour cent, température trente-sept.

cases.notes: Artéméther luméfantrine is ONE drug, not two. Splitting it produces two wrong prescriptions.
cases.text: Diagnostic paludisme. Artéméther luméfantrine matin et soir pendant trois jours.

cases.notes: Two drugs. Each one's modifiers must stop at the next drug, or the first steals the second's frequency.
cases.text: Amoxicilline 500 mg trois fois par jour pendant sept jours et paracétamol 1 g deux fois par jour pendant trois jours.

cases.notes: A recogniser dropping a decimal turns 38.5 into 385. That must be discarded, not recorded.
Already in mmHg. The cmHg rule must not fire and multiply by ten.
Paediatric weight with a decimal, plus height.
cases.text: Poids douze virgule quatre kilos, taille quatre-vingt-quinze centimètres.

cases.notes: Respiratory rate, the IMCI pneumonia trigger, must be extracted not confused with pulse.
cases.text: Fréquence respiratoire quarante-deux par minute, pouls cent trente.

cases.notes: Antenatal visit. No prescription; a spurious one would be a false positive.
cases.text: Motif consultation prénatale. Tension onze sur sept, poids soixante-deux kilos. Diagnostic grossesse évolutive.

cases.notes: Narrative with no measurements at all. Anything extracted here is invented.
Common paediatric presentation with ORS, which has no numeric dose.
cases.text: Motif diarrhée depuis deux jours. Température trente-sept virgule huit, poids neuf kilos. Diagnostic diarrhée aiguë. Sels de réhydratation orale après chaque selle.

cases.notes: Full consultation, the shape a real dictation takes end to end.
cases.text: Motif toux et fièvre depuis cinq jours. Température trente-neuf, pouls cent dix, fréquence respiratoire vingt-huit, saturation quatre-vingt-quatorze pour cent. Diagnostic infection respiratoire basse. Amoxicilline 1 g trois fois par jour pendant sept jours.
